answer: New identities start at zero transaction capacity, earned only by verified useful work for counterparties — like water cutting an inlet through basalt: slow, impossible to fake at scale. Capacity is non-transferable and decays when idle. A farming identity loses all capacity and work history, and gets a fraud flag blocking re-entry for 10 epochs. Each fake must complete 20 verified tasks at about 1,250 POA each: one fake costs 25,000 POA of real work, 1,000 fakes cost 25,000,000 POA, an honest agent pays once. Like karst, the edges stay porous: newcomers face a slow cold start.
